description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing full-text search (FTS) related database operations on 'NewsResourceFtsEntity' objects within an Android app using Room persistence library.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of NewsResourceFtsEntity objects into the database, replacing existing entries on conflict.

methods.name: searchAllNewsResources
methods.description: Performs a full-text search query on the 'newsResourcesFts' table and returns a flow emitting lists of matching news resource IDs.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting the total count of entries in the 'newsResourcesFts' table.
